testResults.command: uv run --extra dev ruff check src/harness/cli/supervisor.py src/harness/cli/trader.py src/lake/storage/azure.py tests/harness/cli/test_supervisor.py && uv run --extra dev ruff format --check ... && uv run --extra dev ty check ...
testResults.result: ruff check, ruff format --check, and ty clean on all touched paths after integration fixes; ty strict on the engine surface with no wall-clock, unseeded random, or network access inside the synchronous kernel (clock and sleep injected; TableKillSwitchPoller is an explicit adapter boundary)

testResults.name: composition-integrity-fixes
testResults.result: Integration fixed six composition-blocking defects found by focused review and live-boot diagnosis: SessionJournal now persists through the SnapshotObjectStore port (RuntimeStateStore exposes no raw store surface); _compose supplies the required kill_switch; the live inboxes compose without the nonexistent clock kwarg; boot recovery wraps SnapshotBrokerStatePort in a real RuntimeReconciler; periodic reconciliation passes ReconcileTrigger.PERIODIC with a correctly advanced sequence; __all__ exports the real phase class name

testResults.name: live-deployment-fixes
testResults.result: Four live-boot defects found and fixed against the deployed dev trader: the websockets transport dependency was missing from the runtime image (SystemExit before any journal write); the deployed trader config referenced an unimplemented market-data adapter and a nonexistent strategy module (repointed to the alpaca_ws SIP feed and BuyAndHoldStrategy); _resolve_credentials keyed resolved values by config field name while checking and subscripting by environment-variable name, so every boot failed the credential gate deterministically; and the live SIP feed interleaves per-symbol timestamps, which the deterministic kernel rejects, fixed by the bounded ReorderingInbox lateness window at the supervision boundary

testResults.name: live-paper-session-and-restart-drill
testResults.command: az containerapp update fca-ml-dev-rth-trader min-replicas 1; az containerapp revision restart; supervision.json + restarts.json + snapshots from harness-state
testResults.result: The deployed supervisor ran a live paper session: 4566 market events consumed, the strategy bought 5 SPY (cash 96161.03, equity 99999.37), periodic snapshots captured, heartbeats and watermark advancing. The mid-session revision restart exercised the full recovery path: the new boot restored via resume_reconcile (action resume, snapshot 2fed09c9) with books intact. The supervision crash-loop gate had earlier engaged exactly as designed during the websockets incident and the durable restart ledger bounded it

limitations: AC1 (a dev paper deployment survives a mid-session container restart) is proven mechanically: the restart drill restored via resume_reconcile with books intact. The restored session then aborted fail-closed on the T216 defect (restored strategy re-entry duplicating a venue fill id); T114 completes once T216 lands and the restart drill reruns with the session continuing
The option ensure route (_ensure_option) retains its own short-circuit and is not repaired by this change
